metadata.description: Mochi, a pixel-art cat companion for Claude Code.

plugins.name: mochi-crew
plugins.description: Mod: a pixel cat in a side pane that reacts to your real session, with a crew of kitten subagents, XP, missions, a session journal, a session meter (model, context, prompt cache, limits or cost), a live file tree and a session badge that gives each session its own place, tab color and title emoji.
